value.rationale: A natural finite-element stability problem is resolved sharply in the minimal nontrivial mesh: exact two Sobolev endpoint constants, unique balanced optimum, extremizers and distinct singular mesh-grading rates. This is a finite-size structural benchmark for mesh quality and derivative-sensitive projection, not merely an algebraic renaming or a known table lookup.
